title: C31-A Strict Temporal Out-of-Sample Holdout on the Newest Never-Scored Window
why_c31: C24 established margin/liquidation fidelity (PASS, consolidated C24_REOPENS_C1_C23). C25/C26 adjudicate cost/funding and intrabar-path fidelity; C27 is next-venue replication; C28 is portfolio-level capital allocation; C29-A is the strict temporal out-of-sample holdout on the archived multiyear window; C30-A is the execution-realism stress. C31-A is the mandatory same-session successor on C30 ACCEPTANCE: PASS: it opens the forward-time holdout frontier (newest never-scored window 2026-09-29 -> 2026-11-21) so the heavy-work queue does not terminate at C30 and no session may claim 'no authorized work'. C31 may NOT launch until C30 ACCEPTANCE: PASS; C30 on C29; C29 on C28; C28 on C27; C27 on C26; C26 on C25; C25 IN FLIGHT.
research_question: Does the pooled spec-literal crash-rebound edge remain positive under the strict_temporal_oos_holdout fidelity axis, across four real venues, when scored on the strict temporal holdout window 2026-09-29T00:00:00Z -> 2026-11-21T00:00:00Z (newest never-scored real data) with the signal path, cost and funding frozen at C25/C26 primary and draw floors intact?
blocked_on: C30-T1 (execution-realism stress), which is blocked on C29, which is blocked on C28, which is blocked on C27, which is blocked on C26, which is blocked on C25. C31 build (this prereg) may proceed before C25/C26/C27/C28/C29/C30 pass, but no C31 cell may run until C30 ACCEPTANCE: PASS and the C30 primary-arm evidence is available as anchor reference, and until the per-venue archive manifest for the holdout window 2026-09-29 -> 2026-11-21 is acquired.

signal_path_frozen.drift_rule: Any artifact whose signal_path/cost/execution fields differ from this prereg are INVALID.

holdout_base.why: C30 primary-arm model re-run on the archived multiyear folds; must reproduce the C30 primary-arm per-venue/per-fold PnL within +/-1.0 (HOLDOUT_ANCHOR_REPRODUCED). Baseline for the holdout direction.

holdout_primary.why: Strict temporal OOS holdout on never-scored real data (the newest window 2026-09-29 -> 2026-11-21 no C1-C30 cell has scored). Pooled sign and CI95 on the holdout window decide whether the edge generalizes forward in time. Requires a fresh archive manifest per venue before any cell infers.

holdout_window.note: newest never-scored window beyond the archived multiyear window (2023-2026YTD ends 2026-09-28); requires a fresh archive manifest <venue>_1h_multiyear_20260929_20261121 before inference

liquidation.rule: Liquidation distance fixed at the C24 primary arm (d15: maint=14, buffer=1 => 15%); not a C31 variable.

arms_rule: ONLY the C31 direction axis varies across arms. All other config fields (signal path + liquidation distance + cost model + funding model) are identical and drift-checked. The FIDELITY_ANCHOR arm reproduces the prior primary-arm baseline within +/-1.0; the PRIMARY arm is the adjudication arm. All arms run the full 4 venues x 4 folds x 20k bootstrap / 20k permutation / 2k placebo — no smoke arm, no reduced draw floors, no descriptive-only arm. The holdout_primary arm additionally requires the per-venue archive manifest for the newest never-scored window.

holdout_fold.note: newest never-scored window beyond the archived multiyear window (2023-2026YTD ends 2026-09-28); requires a fresh archive manifest <venue>_1h_multiyear_20260929_20261121 before inference

inference.pooled: venue-blocked bootstrap over the venue-fold cell totals (20000 draws)

multiplicity.family: primary arm, 4 folds x 4 venues = 16 permutation tests

inference.power_floor: >= 10 trades / >= 5 episodes / >= 5 distinct crash days per fold; otherwise UNDERPOWERED with a power curve.

funding_acquisition.rule: A venue without realized funding history is recorded UNAVAILABLE_FUNDING (never zero-filled) and the realistic arms are evaluated on the remaining venues; okx is UNAVAILABLE_FUNDING by API retention (33-day window).

anchor_rule.rule: Anchor verification against the prior primary arm is mandatory BEFORE any C31 inference cell runs. The fidelity-anchor arm of the selected direction must reproduce the C30 primary-arm per-venue/per-fold PnL within +/-1.0 (HOLDOUT_ANCHOR_REPRODUCED). Anchor mismatch => C31_UNDERPOWERED; no verdict may be issued until the anchor reproduces.

decision_rules.C31_REOPENS_C1_C30: ALL of, under the PRIMARY arm of the selected direction: (a) pooled total PnL > 0; (b) venue-blocked bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0; (c) >= 1 BH survivor in the 16-test primary-arm family; (d) >= 3 of 4 folds positive; (e) >= 3 of 4 venues positive (available venue set). Then the C1-C30 NO_GO is NOT robust to the C31 forward-time holdout axis: record SUPERSEDED_BY_C31 and the edge is re-opened.
decision_rules.C31_NO_GO_ROBUST_TO_HOLDOUT: ANY of (a)-(e) fails under the PRIMARY arm. Then the NO_GO survives the C31 forward-time holdout axis and is strengthened: record C1-C31 NO_GO ROBUST TO MARGIN, COST, PATH, ALLOCATION, HOLDOUT AND EXECUTION REALISM.
C31_UNDERPOWERED: Anchor mismatch, prereg generated after any compute artifact, draw floors not met, missing artifacts, signal-path/cost/execution drift, acquisition gate not passed, or holdout manifest missing.

checkpoint_rule: A (direction, arm, venue, fold) is DONE only when research_state/c31_ckpt_<direction>_<arm>_<venue>_<fold>_<TS>.json exists. Resume with --resume; never relaunch completed folds. A holdout_primary cell whose venue archive manifest for the holdout window is absent is recorded holdout_manifest_missing (no inference).

provenance.caveat: Real exchange USDT-perp data, non-synthetic, CROSS-VENUE vs the Hyperliquid spec; NEVER Hyperliquid performance evidence and never relabelled as such.

guardrails: No synthetic gap-fill; no spec relaxation of RSI/target/hold/sizing/volume/gross cap.

Signal path frozen to the C24/C25/C26/C30 sentinel; liquidation distance fixed at the C24 primary d15; cost model frozen at C25 primary; funding model honest (okx = UNAVAILABLE_FUNDING, never zero-filled or proxied).
No additional venues, folds, or directions beyond those pre-registered for the selected C31 direction.
Artifacts are immutable once written; do not edit completed campaign outputs.
No C31 cell runs until C30 ACCEPTANCE: PASS (sequential adjudication chain).
Draw floors (20k/20k/2k/2k) are not reducible. No reduced-draw runs.
No same-data rerun of a closed campaign; C31-A needs a fresh prereg + anchor verification; the holdout axis varies only the data window (newest never-scored), never the signal path or draw counts.

The holdout_primary arm requires a fresh archive manifest research_state/cache/<venue>_1h_multiyear_20260929_20261121 per venue; absent manifest => cell recorded holdout_manifest_missing, no synthetic data.
